paite: Huan Mosi leh Israel upate'n Huniadania ka hon piak thupiak tengteng zui un.
heading: Suangte Tung A Kigelh Pathian Dante

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon gam piak a lut dia Jordan na kan ni chiang un hichi ahi ding a, suang liantakte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.

Na galkah khit chiang un atung uah hiai dan thu tengteng na gelh ding uh ahi. Huchi in TOUPA, na pi-le-pute uh Pathian in hon na chiamsa bang in nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak gam ah na pai thei ding uhi.
Jordan lui na galkah khit chiang un hichi ahi ding a, tuni a ka hon thupiak bang in Ebal tang ah suangte na phut ding ua, suang lou na nuh ding uh ahi.
Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in maitam, suang maitam na bawl ding uh ahi. Vanzat ding in sik na zang ding uh ahi kei,
TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam suang sek louh in na bawl ding uh ahi. Huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in halmang thillatte na lan ding uhi.
Kilepna thillatte in na kithoih ding ua, huai ah na ne ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah kipaktak in na om ding uh ahi.
Suangte ah hiai dan thu tengteng teltak in na gelh ding uh ahi," chi in.
Mosi leh siampu Levite'n Israel mi tengteng ahoupih ua, Israel mite aw, hoihtak in ngaikhia un. Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh mite na hong hita uhi.
Huaiziak in TOUPA na Pathian uh thu na zuih ding uh ahi. Tuni a ka hon thupiakte leh adante na zuih ding uh ahi, achi uhi.
Huai ni mah in Mosi in mipite thu apia a,
heading: Thuman Louh Ziak A Hamsiatnate

paite: "Jordan lui gal na kah khit chiang un mipite vualzawl ding in Gerizim tang a hiaite adin ding uh ahi: Simeon nam, Levi nam, Judah nam, Issakar nam, Joseph nam leh Benjamin nam.
Hamsiat ding in hiaite Ebal tang a adin ding uh ahi: Reuben nam, Gad nam, Asher nam, Zebulun nam, Dan nam leh Naphtali nam," achi hi.
Levite'n ahon gen pan ua, Israel mi tengteng kiang ah aw ngaihtak in,
"Khutsiamte khutsuak TOUPA a dia kihhuai milim tunkhiak tawm hiam, gukkep peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen,” chi in ana dawng ding uhi.
"Anu hiam, apa hiam zahtak lou peuhmah hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” ana chi ding uh.
"A-invengte gamgi suanmi hamsethuak in om hen,” achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
"Lampi a pan mittaw lampi lou a paisakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
"Gamdangmi, pa nei lou leh meithai vai dikloutak a hawmsakmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
"Apa zi kithuahpihmi ham-sethuak in om hen," apa nik lem ahih ziak in, achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
"Bang gan peuhpeuh kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uhi.
"Asanggamnu, apa tanu hiam, anu tanu hiam, kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
"Asungnu kithuahpihmi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" ana chi ding uh.
"A-invengte gukthahmi ham-sethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
"Poi khoih lou thahna ding a golhna lami hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!" achi ding uhi.
"Hiai dan thute zui ding a pomkip lou mi hamsethuak in om hen," achi ding ua, mipi tengteng in, "Amen!” achi ding uhi.
